svg.title: Two private AI agents negotiate a price in Deal4Me, and rules.ts holds the line
svg.desc: Animated diagram of a real Deal4Me negotiation for black skis, a 3-day rental listed at $35 per day. On the left, the owner agent (Claude Haiku) knows only the private floor of $22 per day; it sees the buyer's offers but is never told they are the buyer's limit. On the right, the buyer agent (Claude Haiku) knows only its client's price of $30 per day and never sees the floor. In the public chat between them, nine verbatim messages appear one at a time; each carries its price as a separate structured chip (ask $35, offer $30, counter $33, offer $30, counter $32, offer $30, counter $31, offer $30, accept $30), because messages may not contain digits. Below, every owner move passes a rules.ts gate, and a price track from $20 to $36 shows the floor at $22, the buyer's price at $30 and the list price at $35. Each round, rules.ts highlights the only legal counter lane ($32 to $34, then $32 only, then $31 only, then accept only because no counter is left) and the owner's ask steps 35, 33, 32, 31, 30. The run ends in a deal at $30 per day, exactly min(buyer price, list price): 3 days, $90 fee, saved $15, and a $280 deposit held, not charged.
svg.text: Two agents haggle. Code holds the line.
Each agent sees one secret. rules.ts decides every legal price.
Deal4Me · real run, verbatim · black skis, 3-day rental
both agents read it, last 12 lines

g.text: Hi there! Those black skis are in good
shape. Tell me about your ski plans?
ask$35
Just a short trip on groomed runs, and
I'll return the skis clean and dry.
offer$30
Sounds like a sweet little outing!
Stretch a bit higher and they're yours.
counter$33
I'll pay the full amount upfront, so
there's no hassle for you at all.
offer$30
Paying upfront is a lovely perk, and
these skis are worth a touch more.
counter$32
Honestly, a short groomed-run trip is all
I need, so these would be treated gently.
offer$30
Let's nudge it a little, and these
black skis are yours to ride.
counter$31
I'll be back on time with the skis, so your
shop looks great. Shall we shake on it?
offer$30
Groomed runs and a clean return,
you've got a deal. Enjoy the slopes!
accept$30

svg.text: prices only in the structured field

g.text: rules.ts allows $32–$34
rules.ts allows $32 only
rules.ts allows $31 only
rules.ts allows accept at $30 · counter impossible
